E3003

`deadline exceeded while waiting in {wait_kind}`.

What

`deadline exceeded while waiting in {wait_kind}`.

Why

A wait/IO point observed an active `#Context(deadline: …)` budget and the remaining time reached zero before the operation completed.

Fix

Raise the deadline budget, shorten the work before the wait point, or remove/adjust the ambient deadline for this scope.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3003: tests/ui/runtime_e3003.stderr.

Error [E3003]: deadline exceeded while waiting in task join
 Why: this wait point observed the task context deadline from `#Context(deadline: …)`
 Fix: raise the deadline budget or shorten the work before this wait point
